what: Synthetic System-log records for the sanitized dashboard screenshots. Windows' public providers, event ids and Microsoft's own message templates only; no record here was read from any real machine.
how: minutes_ago is materialized into TimeCreated against the capture moment by docs/screens/fixtures/fixture-server.py, exactly as tests/fixtures/whea-records.json's loader does. Two evenings, each: a quiet stretch of informational records, a Display 4101 warning, the start triad (Kernel-General 12, Kernel-Power 41, EventLog 6008) six minutes later, then recovery.
